[F008] The fix is confirmed end-to-end. The `capabilities` item now reports `optional_unconfigured` (non-optimistic) when 0 adapters are ready, while staying `optional: true` so core use is never blocked.

Side-effect commands invoked:

$ PYTHONPATH=scripts python -m pytest scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_config_inventory_f008.py -q
$ PYTHONPATH=scripts python -c "from dontpanic_orchestrate import config_inventory as ci; ..."

**Finding [medium, correctness] — optimistic capabilities/adapters status:** Addressed. `provider_capabilities` in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/config_inventory.py` previously hardcoded `status=Status.OK` regardless of readiness, so it reported `ok` while saying "4 capabilities/adapters known, 0 ready." I now derive the aggregate from the dedicated capability surface's own `capabilities_status.run_status` envelope: the status is `OK` only when at least one capability is `ready`, and falls back to `OPTIONAL_UNCONFIGURED` (a non-ok optional band) when no adapter is ready or none are known. Crucially `optional` stays `True`, so the surface never lands in the required-incomplete bucket and never blocks core use (AC4). I added a regression test `test_capabilities_status_not_optimistic_when_none_ready` that cross-checks the inventory aggregate against the live `run_status` ready-count and asserts non-ok-when-zero-ready plus the optional/non-required invariants.
